name: docs_read

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

rootId.description: Id of the depth-0 project root that owns the document: a full UUID or 8 to 32 hex characters.

kind.description: Document kind: plan, rule or page. On list it is optional and filters.

slug.description: Document slug, unique per (root, kind). [select: get, history, links]

version.description: Read this stored version (at least 1) instead of the current one. Not together with ifVersion. [select: get]

ifVersion.description: The version the caller already holds (at least 1). When it equals the current version the answer is {unchanged: true, version} with no body. [select: get]

includeArchived.description: Include archived documents. Default false. [select: list]

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 200 (default 50). [select: list, history, links]

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's page.next. [select: list, history, links]

direction.description: outgoing = links the document makes, incoming = links that point at it. Default all. [select: links]

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Read the versioned documents of a project root. select: get (one document or one stored version), list (metadata only), history (versions) or links (what the document links to and what links to it). Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
